comparison.scope: The general-graph search in every inspected top-20 submission is Dijkstra. Some have separate special-case algorithms.
reusable_candidates: Small-queue linear minimum before radix migration
Direct extraction from a singleton bucket
Cached minima versus SIMD minimum scans

queue_tradeoffs.cached_minimum: 407097 updates one minimum during insertion and redistribution, avoiding a separate minimum scan at refill.
queue_tradeoffs.simd_scan: 404592 scans record keys at refill, uses scalar reduction below 8 records and AVX2 otherwise.
queue_tradeoffs.circular_32bit: 407097 packs key and vertex into 8 bytes. Correct ordering depends on a bounded live-key window; its topological initial frontier can require a 64-bit fallback.
queue_tradeoffs.general_64bit: 404592 accepts monotone unsigned 64-bit keys without a maximum-edge bound. Its key/vertex records occupy 16 bytes and bucket zero stores only vertices.
queue_tradeoffs.inline: All three use a linear minimum for at most 32 pending records and migrate permanently once that limit is crossed.

target_contract: A finite tentative target distance is an upper bound on the optimal target distance.
If every queued key is at least that bound, nonnegative edges cannot improve it.
The target need not enter the queue.
Suppressing other sinks and stopping early do not preserve final distances to all vertices.
Apply these optimizations only to an explicitly single-target API, preserving the all-distances contract.
comparison.separate_algorithm_policy: Keep the default Dijkstra API; enable topological preprocessing only through the explicit dijkstra<true> and dijkstra_path<true> extension. No deterministic-walk or BFS branch is included.
comparison.measurement_caveat: API times include parsing, graph construction, path output, and special-case branches; they do not isolate the Dijkstra kernel.
comparison.judge_environment: The public submission API returns lang=cpp and case timings, but does not identify the historical compiler version, flags, or CPU. Do not infer local performance from API rank.
comparison.license: No explicit license grant was found in the inspected submission sources. Sources remain in the ignored reference cache; compare algorithmic ideas and independently implement repository code.
